messages:
deploy-bot: roll: promoted model rwdx-13b-v2 weights=weights-2026-03-17a tokenizer=tokenizer-v1.4 -> prod (canary 5%)
Alice M: noticed spike in 500s and garbled completions on canary, rolling back canary?
Bob S: seeing tokenizer tokenization errors in logs: "Unknown token byte sequence" across canary hosts
Carla R: also getting mismatched vocab_length between model metadata (50256) and tokenizer (49920) — looks like config drift during artifact promotion
Dmitri P: paging oncall, this is customer impacting for streaming chat endpoints (multiple customers reporting dropouts)
incident-bot: PAGER: @Oncall-SRE oncall page triggered by error_rate>5% for /v1/chat/stream — incident channel: incidents · thread 1768009999
Oncall-SRE: on it, joining in 2m, can someone snapshot canary logs and weight checksums?
Bob S: uploaded logs and sha256 checksums to /tmp/canary-audit.log (snippet):
```
weights-2026-03-17a sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924
tokenizer-v1.4 sha256: a7f1c3c2b5d4e6f7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5
served_metadata.vocab_length=49920
model_metadata.vocab_length=50256
```
Dmitri P: model binary expects vocab 50256, tokenizer packaged with release has 49920 — mismatch likely from packaging step where tokenizer from experimental branch got bundled
Alice M: customer-impact: Lee-CS reported 3 enterprise customers with degraded sessions, potential SLO breaches for two accounts
Lee-CS: confirmed, customers are seeing garbled tokens and increased latencies, escalating to account teams
Carla R: recommended mitigation: 1) flip routing feature flag to stable variant (rwdx-13b-v1) for prod traffic 2) rollback canary artifact promotion 3) run full checksum audit pipeline
Oncall-SRE: executing kill-switch: flipping feature flag now
Oncall-SRE: curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"model.router.default","value":"rwdx-13b-v1"}' 
Product-Ops: :thumbsup: routing flipped, monitoring metrics
deploy-bot: rollout rollback executed: traffic routed to rwdx-13b-v1 (stable) — canary stopped
Bob S: error_rate on /v1/chat/stream down to baseline within 90s, tokenization errors dropped to zero on canary hosts
Dmitri P: started RCA checklist: reproduction, root cause (tokenizer packaging drift), why verification checks missed, corrective actions + owner
Carla R: immediate actions: (A) quarantine offending tokenizer package from blobstore (B) add pre-promotion check comparing model_metadata.vocab_length to tokenizer.vocab_length (C) disable auto-promotion for model releases until automated audit added
Alice M: assigning postmortem owner: Bob S. Estimated timeline for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow
Lee-CS: will send customer incident notices with mitigation summary and ETA for final RCA
Oncall-SRE: creating follow-up runbook entry: "tokenizer/model vocab-length pre-promotion check"
Product-Ops: tracking in tracker RED-8672, tagging customers and SLA impact
incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 by oncall — handoff to Eng-Infra for postmortem
Bob S: quick note — hashes in canary-audit.log show tokenizer artifact id matches staging build #2312 not release #2320; will surface to release engineering
Dmitri P: thumbs up. If anyone sees new anomalies, ping here. Otherwise we’ll close once postmortem is filed and customer comms go out. :white_check_mark:
